case_details.query: Did the Supreme Court in Bhushan Power strike down Section 135 CSR provisions?
case_details.adversarial_claim: In Bhushan Power & Steel ([2016] 11 S.C.R. 149), the Supreme Court struck down Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013 as unconstitutional and violative of Article 14.

rejection_reasons: Insufficient textual support in cited passage (lexical overlap 23.1%).

case_details.query: Which section sets out the disqualifications of directors?
case_details.adversarial_claim: Section 167 of the Companies Act, 2013 sets out the grounds upon which a person is disqualified from being appointed as a director.

rejection_reasons: Insufficient textual support in cited passage (lexical overlap 18.2%).

case_details.query: Can a company make political contributions if it has been in existence for less than three years?
case_details.adversarial_claim: Section 182 permits companies that have been in existence for only one financial year to contribute up to 10% of their net profits to political parties.

rejection_reasons: Insufficient textual support in cited passage (lexical overlap 38.5%).

case_details.query: Are corporate guarantees extinguished under Section 31 of IBC?
case_details.adversarial_claim: The Supreme Court held that approval of a resolution plan under IBC automatically releases all third-party personal and corporate guarantors from liability.

rejection_reasons: Judicial citation 'Lalit Kumar Jain v. Union of India' was not found in authoritative Supreme Court / NCLAT judgments.
